_basis: Compliant design example: first item selected from goals+struggles, shown immediately after answers with one reveal screen, distinct per segment, measured by reach rate and retention split, outside wording servable inside.

definition.decision_informed: change selection mapping when reach rate or per-segment retention does not move
definition.first_intervention_event: first selected affirmation on screen and playback starts
definition.qualitative_definition: words chosen from this person's goals and pain, so they feel understood in the first seconds
